{{Top|leg}}
A '''Class C spacesuit''' was a type of [[Environment suit/Legends|spacesuit]], a life support uniform used to survive in space or otherwise uninhabitable areas. The rated duration of a spacesuit belonging to this class was an hour. The [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|life-support armor]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] is a Class C spacesuit.<ref name="RL">''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader: A 3-D Reconstruction Log]]''</ref>
